quest.title: Inspiration Eruption
quest.description: Buies from Mondstadt seems to be thinking about something...

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: This type of game sure is inspiring, hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What new game?

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: Traveler! Good timing! I happen to need someone to playtest my new game.

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: Look here. I'm calling this game "Inspiration Eruption."

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: It perfectly captures the entire process of how we poets create poetry!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean drinking, drinking, and more drinking?

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: Hahaha, hilarious. Though using wine to let one's creative juices flow is certainly a good idea.

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: However, wine alone is not enough to inspire truly extraordinary poetry.

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: Before we write a poem, we have to start by seeking out inspiration.

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: Some like to travel, some prefer solitude, while others... really enjoy using wine to stimulate their creativity.

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: This is the most challenging part, since we cannot pinpoint where inspiration lies.

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: So most of the time we feel like we haven't found our muse, and become anxious and depressed...

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: But in truth, inspiration has already visited us and left its mark inside our heads without us ever knowing.

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: At the right juncture, they will come bursting out and take the form of a great poem... or a painting... or something else.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you can turn all that into a game?

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Of course! The process of making poetry is quite clear and easily understood.

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: It just so happens that there are a few tabletop game designers in Mondstadt interested in my ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: After some discussions and a few brainstorming sessions, we finally came up with "Inspiration Eruption"!

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: You can try it right now if you're interested.

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: Play a few rounds, and maybe you'll become a poet yourself!
